notes: The official CaltechAUTHORS record exposes 25 downloadable files totaling 271.9 MB and explicitly lists a front-matter PDF, one PDF for each of Chapters 1–14, five appendix PDFs, and complete back matter. The downloaded 17-page front matter is unencrypted and its contents were extracted locally to verify every top-level title and starting page. Bibliographic sources identify xvi + 911 printed pages. Four shards were selected because the complete source is substantially larger than 350 pages; their approximate lengths are 187, 206, 266, and 252 pages, and every split is strictly between numbered chapters.
